name: rendered-prompt golden — exact minijinja output for stages.* and review.* namespaces (inline)
workflow_starlark:
implement = stage(id = "implement", agent = "default", prompt = "Do the task.{% if review.iteration > 0 %} Address feedback: {{ review.feedback }}{% endif %}")
review = stage(id = "review", agent = "default", depends_on = ["implement"], prompt = "Review this output: {{ stages.implement.content }}", outputs = {"verdict": "string", "feedback": "string"})
loop(body = implement, gate = review, max_iterations = 3, on_exhaustion = "fail")
workflow("rendered-prompt-golden", root = [implement])
